Test.title: Test
Test.description: Represents a Mu Alpha Theta test.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Test entity.

year.description: The year the test was administered.

division.description: The division of the test (e.g., Algebra I, Geometry).

month.description: The month the test was administered (e.g., January, February).

test_type.description: The type of the test (e.g., Regional, Invitational, Individual).

pdfUrl.description: URL of the PDF document for the test.

solutionId.description: Reference to the Solution entity. (Relationship: Test 1:1 Solution)

Solution.title: Solution
Solution.description: Represents the solution key for a Mu Alpha Theta test.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Solution entity.

year.description: The year the solution key is for.

month.description: The month the solution key is for.

division.description: The division the solution key is for (e.g., Algebra I).

test_type.description: The type of test the solution is for(e.g. Regional).

answers.description: An array containing the correct answers for the test.

TestSubmission.title: TestSubmission
TestSubmission.description: Represents a user's score on a particular test.

userId.description: Reference to the User entity. (Relationship: User 1:N UserScore)

testId.description: Reference to the Test entity. (Relationship: Test 1:N UserScore)

score.description: The user's score on the test.

submittedAt.description: The timestamp when the test was submitted.

definition.description: Stores Mu Alpha Theta test details.
Stores the solution keys for the tests.
Stores user scores for each test. Path-based ownership ensures only the user can access their scores.
